planner.question: Reduce the unrestricted SAT lower bound against every polynomial-time deterministic algorithm to a fixed machine and an explicit adversarial formula family.
planner.strategy: Construct a charged universal verified witness scheduler and derive a uniform bounded-failure CNF equivalence.
planner.alternative: Audit direct diagonalization against the same machine, input and clock; test bounded failure formulas.
planner.stop_rule: Do not claim counterexample existence from the encoding itself, or substitute a restricted-model lower bound.
literature_leads: Classical universal search, SAT self-reducibility and bounded Turing computation encoding; no novelty claim.

construct.claim: P=NP iff one fixed universal verified SAT search U has polynomial success time on all satisfiable inputs; P!=NP iff for every k infinitely many n admit a bad witness at stage k ceil(log2 L).
construct.scope: Arbitrary encoded deterministic Turing algorithms, explicit normalized universal clause selector encoding, total bit-cost bound.
construct.derivation: Dovetail all binary descriptions with length-weighted clocks and check witnesses; self-reduction gives one competitor iff P=NP; bounded simulation gives exact counterexample CNFs.
unresolved_steps: Prove or disprove existence of bad witnesses for every exponent at arbitrarily large lengths.
candidate_tests: Enumerate bounded stages on all small selectors, verify actual general interpreter, and compile finite failure predicates.

alternative.claim: Bounded counterexample encoding alone cannot force a diagonal failure: solving H can refer to a different input length and clock; finite bad sets may be empty.
alternative.scope: Same unrestricted witness machine, explicit CNF encoding, polynomially charged construction; no restricted oracle premise.
alternative.derivation: Distinguish existential failure search at length L from the runtime on its larger encoding; give conditional computable hard sequence and charge its discovery.
unresolved_steps: A resource-preserving adversarial formula construction or universal polynomial success bound.
candidate_tests: Check exact bad-set counts, empty sets, invalid program outputs and hard clock cutoffs.

objections: Universal search must include arbitrary machines, not just a finite portfolio.
Soundness on UNSAT comes from verification, not claimed rejection.

Finite nonempty or empty counterexample sets do not decide asymptotic existence.
counterexample_candidates: The small fixture bad sets become empty at stage four.
A larger encoding of a bounded failure predicate does not create a fixed-length diagonal contradiction.
critic.equivalence_audit: Uniform encoding, length-weighted stage costs, verified success, two directions of P=NP equivalence and exact all-k infinitely-many-n negation.
critic.barrier_audit: Unrestricted lower bound is the primary unproved obligation; no resolution or restricted-model substitute.

cost.computational_model: Deterministic ordinary bit computation, explicit binary Turing descriptions, verified SAT witnesses and bounded CNF encoding.
